# growthbook_attribute (Data Source)

Reads a single GrowthBook SDK targeting attribute by property.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "growthbook_attribute" "plan_tier" {
  property = "plan_tier"
}

output "plan_tier_datatype" {
  value = data.growthbook_attribute.plan_tier.datatype
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `property` (String) Attribute property name, and its identifier.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether this attribute is archived.
- `datatype` (String) Attribute datatype.
- `description` (String) Description of the attribute.
- `enum` (String) Comma-separated list of allowed values.
- `format` (String) Attribute format.
- `hash_attribute` (Boolean) Whether this attribute is hashed before being sent to the SDK.
- `projects` (Set of String) Project ids this attribute is scoped to.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to this attribute.
